question: How does the code workspace view present the seamless switch and side panels (R12)?
options: A: inline expansion inside the chat header (status quo S7 slivers)
B: dedicated full-page workspace at /app/code/:sessionId with a left panel rail and the computer screen as the main area
C: modal overlay over the chat
why: R12 requires panels as first-class surfaces outside the computer screen and a real destination for the switch; a full page matches the confirmed purpose map and the ArtifactsPage full-page precedent. Inline (A) is the discoverability defect being fixed; a modal (C) cannot host persistent panels.

layout.switch: persistent Chat/Code segmented control on the bot header; Code creates-or-reattaches the bot's active session and navigates to /app/code/:sessionId
layout.rail: left rail with Terminal / Files / Git panels; panel opens beside (not over) the computer screen; panels render only what the session supports (progressive disclosure)
layout.terminal: existing xterm LiveTerminal; lands in bash with omp already running for omp sessions; view-only banner-free — input disabled until control lease held (take control button appears only when a run holds the lease)
layout.files: file tree from codingSessions.listFiles; click opens read-only preview from codingSessions.readFile
layout.gitGraph: commit graph from codingSessions.gitGraph; empty truthful state when not a repo

reversal: alias the route or re-dock panels; no data-model coupling
